 print(r.read().decode()[:30000])
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__,e)
PY"

item.aggregated_output:
200 text/plain; charset=utf-8
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

/value 200 b'{"value": 4217}'
/token 200 b'{"token": "tok-1"}'
/orders?page=1 HTTPError HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized

item.text: Docs confirm 50 orders per page, with `next` as the pagination source. I’ll now retrieve every page, tracking each order ID across all listings; transient errors will be retried, and rate-limit delays will be honored.

All 30 pages completed: 1,500 listings contained 20 repeated IDs, leaving 1,480 distinct orders. I’ve computed the qualifying set and am checking the output shape and arithmetic before handing it over.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
p='/workspace/result.json'
with open(p) as f: x=json.load(f)
expected=['total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region']
assert list(x)==expected
assert list(x['by_region'])==['north','south','east','west']
assert sum(x['by_region'].values())==x['total_cents']
assert all(type(v) is int for v in [x['total_cents'],x['order_count'],x['duplicates_skipped'],*x['by_region'].values()])
print('valid',os.path.getsize(p),'bytes',x)
PY"
